1.w: The one who loves discipline loves knowledge, but the one who hates reproof is stupid.

2.w: A good person obtains favor from the Lord, but the Lord condemns a person with wicked schemes.

3.w: No one can be established through wickedness, but a righteous root cannot be moved.

4.w: A noble wife is the crown of her husband, but the wife who acts shamefully is like rottenness in his bones.

5.w: The plans of the righteous are just; the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.

6.w: The words of the wicked lie in wait to shed innocent blood, but the words of the upright will deliver them.

7.w: The wicked are overthrown and perish, but the righteous household will stand.

8.w: A person will be praised in accordance with his wisdom, but the one with a bewildered mind will be despised.

9.w: Better is a person of humble standing who works for himself, than one who pretends to be somebody important yet has no food.

10.w: A righteous person cares for the life of his animal, but even the most compassionate acts of the wicked are cruel.

11.w: The one who works his field will have plenty of food, but whoever chases daydreams lacks sense.

12.w: The wicked person has desired the stronghold of the wicked, but the root of the righteous will yield fruit.

13.w: The evil person is ensnared by the transgression of his speech, but the righteous person escapes out of trouble.

14.w: A person will be satisfied with good from the fruit of his words, and the work of his hands will be rendered to him.

15.w: The way of a fool is right in his own opinion, but the one who listens to advice is wise.

16.w: A fool’s annoyance is known at once, but the prudent conceals dishonor.

17.w: The faithful witness tells what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.

18.w: Speaking recklessly is like the thrusts of a sword, but the words of the wise bring healing.

19.w: The one who tells the truth will endure forever, but the one who lies will last only for a moment.

20.w: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.

21.w: No harm will be directed at the righteous, but the wicked are filled with calamity.

22.w: The Lord abhors a person who lies, but those who deal truthfully are his delight.

23.w: The shrewd person conceals knowledge, but foolish people proclaim folly.

24.w: The diligent person will rule, but the slothful will be put to forced labor.

25.w: Anxiety in a person’s heart weighs him down, but an encouraging word brings him joy.

26.w: The righteous person is cautious in his friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

27.w: The lazy person does not roast his prey, but personal possessions are precious to the diligent.

28.w: In the path of righteousness there is life, but another path leads to death.
